presets.name: AWS Bedrock
presets.description: Amazon Bedrock. It has no endpoint setting: the region determines where requests go, and the model id must match one your account has access to in that region.

apikey.help: AWS access key id for an IAM user with bedrock:InvokeModel.

apisecret.help: The secret shown once when the access key was created.

model.help: The Bedrock model id, which must be enabled for your account in the chosen region.
